description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, which extends ListActivity to display a list of cheeses using a custom adapter named MyAdapter.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends ListActivity to show a list of cheeses with a custom adapter.

classes.name: MyAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter subclass extending BaseAdapter to provide list items for the cheese list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and sets the custom list adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cheese items available.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the cheese item at a specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item at the specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or updates a list item view for the specified position.
